reddit_quotes: I've used Benchmade Griptilian for 12 months. Not worth the premium.
Benchmade Griptilian is the kind of thing you don't appreciate until you've used the cheap alternative and regretted it.
The Benchmade Griptilian community is split, but the people who actually own them tend to keep them.
detractor_quote: I returned my Benchmade Griptilian after two weeks. The marketing is better than the product.
